en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes up 59 points at 24271
en.dek: The index finished 0.25 per cent higher after an early rally faded, with mainland banks among the stronger performers and turnover at about 162.6 billion dollars.
body: The Hang Seng Index closed at 24,271.20 on Monday, up 59.85 points or 0.25 per cent. It had opened higher and reached an intraday peak above 24,455 before giving back most of the gains in the afternoon.

Main-board turnover stood at roughly 162.6 billion Hong Kong dollars. Mainland bank shares rose, with China Merchants Bank up more than 3 per cent and China Construction Bank and Bank of China each gaining close to 2 per cent or more.

The Hang Seng Tech Index ended lower at 4,169.57, down 0.67 per cent. Xiaomi fell more than 5 per cent while several other technology names were mixed. Property stocks also lagged, with the sector index down about 1 per cent.

Among blue chips, Orient Overseas International was one of the stronger performers after reporting a rise in third-quarter revenue. Gold-related shares declined, with Laopu Gold among the day's larger losers.

zh.headline: 恒指高收59點報24271 內銀股造好
zh.dek: 恒指全日升0.25%，早段曾高見24455點後回吐，主板成交約1626億元。
body: 恒生指數周一收報24271.20點，升59.85點或0.25%。大市高開後曾高見超過24455點，下午升幅收窄。
主板全日成交額約1626億港元。內銀股表現較佳，招商銀行升逾3%，建設銀行及中國銀行各升近2%或以上。
恒生科技指數收報4169.57點，跌0.67%。小米集團跌逾5%，其他科技股個別發展。地產股亦偏弱，分類指數跌約1%。
藍籌股中，東方海外因上季收入上升而造好。黃金相關股份則下跌，老鋪黃金是跌幅較大的成分股之一。
